<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion is at m/z ≈ 141.1, which matches the monoisotopic mass of the formula C₈H₁₀Cl (exact mass = 141.047 Da). The M+1 intensity (~9 %) is consistent with ~8–9 carbons, supporting this formula. A simple structure that fits C₈H₁₀Cl and has 4 degrees of unsaturation (typical of an aromatic ring) is 1‑chloropropylbenzene (also called 4‑chloropropylbenzene). Its SMILES representation is **Clc1ccc(cc1)CC**. This SMILES is valid, matches the formula, and is a plausible candidate for the observed mass. 

<final_answer>Clc1ccc(cc1)CC</final_answer>
